title: UCC-wise details of the running account settlement (NSE member portal)
when: Within 10 trading days of each running account settlement
purpose: Client by client, what the firm retained and what it paid at a running account settlement, with the bank accounts, the transfer mode, and when the statement and the SMS and email went to the client (17 fields). One CSV in a ZIP of the same name, uploaded on the member portal under Inspection > Statement Upload > Settlement Statement > Submit Data > Submit UCC wise Details.
linked: Written from Ledgerline's running account settlement batches (paid and retained-only clients) on Receipts & payouts → Running account
source: Fields 1-10: NSE/INSP/55135 (5 Jan 2023), file name PAN_QS_DDMMYYYY(_SeqNo), one CSV per ZIP, bank account numbers in double quotes. Fields 11-17: the revised format from the settlement of 6 Oct 2023 (BSE notice 20230929-39; MSE/INSP/14235/2023; NCDEX/COMPLIANCE-100/2023 of 29 Sep 2023), as listed in NCDEX's Master Circular - Member Inspection 2025-26 (NCDEX/MEMBER INSPECTION-013/2026 of 30 Apr 2026), Annexure A. Data rules: NSE/INSP/56148 (27 Mar 2023), Annexure 1. Not confirmed: the header text of NSE's current portal template, the date in the file name (the settlement date here; NSE/INSP/55135 gave the quarter-end date when settlement was quarterly) what fields 11 to 17 hold for a client whose funds were only retained (NA here), and whether the first file may carry the sequence number _01 (every file has one here, so a corrected file never repeats a name; NSE/INSP/55135 adds it when more files are needed).

columns.name: TM Bank account number
columns.note: The account the client was paid from: one reported as a Down Streaming Client Nodal Bank Account (DSCNBA) under enhanced supervision; in double quotes; NA when nothing was paid

columns.name: TM Bank IFSC
columns.note: IFSC of the bank the settlement is paid from; NA when nothing was paid

columns.name: Client Bank Account Number
columns.note: In double quotes; NA when nothing was paid

columns.name: Whether funds transferred through electronic mode

codes.No: Paid otherwise (give the reason in the next field)
codes.NA: Nothing paid: the funds were only retained (not confirmed)
